building.core.castle.grail.description: The presence of the Colossus increases weekly creature generation by 50%, provides your kingdom with an additional 5000 gold each day, and increases the morale of all your heroes by +2.
building.core.castle.tavern.description: The Tavern allows hiring heroes, hearing the latest gossip and visiting the Thieves' Guild. It also increases morale for troops defending the city.
